title: Improved Weyl bounds on short intervals
summary: For an integer $d\ge 3$, put $Δ_d=\min{2^{d-1},d(d-1)}$. Let $a/q$ be reduced, let $P(X)=\frac{a}{q}X^d+α_{d-1}X^{d-1}+\cdots+α_0$, and let $\mathcal{I}$ be an interval of $H\le q$ consecutive integers. We prove $\left|\sum_{n\in\mathcal{I}}e(P(n))\right|\ll_{d,\varepsilon}q^{1/d}H^\varepsilon+H^{1-1/Δ_d+\varepsilon}$.
